cells.quote: The study analyzed changes in average daily attendance from 2000 to 2001, finding that NNPS schools increased attendance by 0.5% on average, while comparison schools experienced a slight decline. The positive, statistically significant results (effect size = +0.07) highlight the role of structured family and community involvement in improving attendance, earning NNPS a “Promising” evidence rating.
cells.note: The study text reports a quasi-experimental comparison of NNPS schools with matched comparison schools; expertise and learning knowledge type are not stated.
